a.lede: Malaysia is investigating possible re-exports of Nvidia AI hardware amid concerns about circumvention of U.S. restrictions on China as Singapore charges an executive over suspicious purchases of 917 AI servers.
a.title: Malaysia and Singapore step up Nvidia AI chip probes amidst Jensen Huang controversy

b.lede: With a big checkbook and sought-after chips, Nvidia’s CEO had his thumb on the world of AI. An extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy may put all of that at risk.
b.title: Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling
